actual_actions.reason: Fresh nested v43 inventory, accessible Drive project references, current GitHub project state, and CAB public IXOR+ documentation did not bind a project-specific centering owner. The result is bounded source-search exhaustion, not proof of global nonexistence.
HERMA and Aesus sources demonstrate plausible roller-prism and roller-against-wrap-belt mechanism classes, but none transfers geometry, dimensions, actuation, or design intent into CAB/v43.

The previously declared source-exhaustion boundary is reached for accessible sources. The next phase therefore engineers and tests candidate product-handling mechanisms explicitly rather than treating v43 Candidate A as discovered OEM intent.

conclusion: PLAN-0010 completed its current accessible source-discovery branch without resolving CAPTURE_KINEMATIC_OWNER. Unknownness is preserved. The project moves to PLAN-0011: mechanism-independent Proof-of-Principle requirements and explicit candidate engineering. New authoritative integration evidence may reopen source discovery at any time.
